theme: Kể về dự án đáng nhớ

vocab.example: We set a milestone at the end of every sprint.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đặt một cột mốc quan trọng vào cuối mỗi sprint.

vocab.example: I led a cross-functional team of developers and testers.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã dẫn dắt một nhóm liên phòng ban gồm lập trình viên và tester.

vocab.example: We defined the scope of work with the stakeholders first.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi xác định phạm vi công việc với các bên liên quan trước.

vocab.example: Every stakeholder agreed on the project plan.
vocab.example_vi: Mọi bên liên quan đều đồng ý với kế hoạch dự án.

vocab.example: The project had a very tight timeline to launch.
vocab.example_vi: Dự án có thời hạn rất gấp rút để ra mắt.

vocab.example: My key contribution was designing the migration plan.
vocab.example_vi: Đóng góp then chốt của tôi là thiết kế kế hoạch di chuyển dữ liệu.

vocab.example: The change had a measurable impact on performance.
vocab.example_vi: Sự thay đổi đó có tác động đo lường được đến hiệu suất.

vocab.example: The final deliverable was ready two days early.
vocab.example_vi: Sản phẩm bàn giao cuối cùng đã sẵn sàng sớm hai ngày.

lines.speaker: Trang (Interviewer)
lines.text: Duy, can you tell me about a memorable project from your last job?

lines.speaker: Duy (Candidate)
lines.text: Sure. I worked on a project to migrate our system, and it had a very tight timeline.

lines.speaker: Trang (Interviewer)
lines.text: What was your role in that project?

lines.speaker: Duy (Candidate)
lines.text: I led a cross-functional team of developers and testers.

lines.speaker: Trang (Interviewer)
lines.text: How did you handle the scope of work?

lines.speaker: Duy (Candidate)
lines.text: We first defined the scope of work clearly with all the stakeholders.

lines.speaker: Trang (Interviewer)
lines.text: Were there any important milestones along the way?

lines.speaker: Duy (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, we set weekly milestones to track our progress.

lines.speaker: Trang (Interviewer)
lines.text: What was your key contribution to the project?

lines.speaker: Duy (Candidate)
lines.text: My key contribution was designing the data migration plan, which had a measurable impact on performance.

lines.speaker: Duy (Candidate)
lines.text: The final deliverable was a fully migrated system, delivered two days early.

questions.q: What was Duy's role in the project?
What did the team define first?

options: A fully migrated system delivered early

shadowing: I worked on a project with a very tight timeline last year.
I led a cross-functional team of developers and testers on it.

We set weekly milestones to track our progress on the project.
My key contribution had a measurable impact on the final deliverable.
